children: Korn Ferry reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 fee revenue of $756.5 million, up 7% year-over-year, and net income attributable to Korn Ferry of $69.0 million (margin 9.1%). Adjusted EBITDA was $128.2 million with a 17.0% margin and adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.43 for the quarter. The company noted estimated remaining fees under existing contracts of $1.9 billion and continued momentum across Search and Workforce Solutions.
Fee revenue: $756.5 million for Q1 FY27, up 7% year-over-year (also +7% at constant currency).
Total revenue: $764.6 million for Q1 FY27.
Net income attributable to Korn Ferry: $69.0 million; net income margin: 9.1%.
Adjusted EBITDA: $128.2 million; adjusted EBITDA margin: 17.0%.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share: $1.43; diluted EPS: $1.32.
Sixth consecutive quarter of top-line growth, with fee revenue up across all regions.
Strong segment performance: Search and Workforce Solutions led growth with double-digit increases (Search up 10.4% consolidated; Workforce Solutions up 11.1% consolidated).
Estimated remaining fees under existing contracts totaled $1.9 billion, a 14% increase year-over-year.
New business awarded in the quarter was $832.3 million, reflecting increased client engagements and fee earner productivity of $1,840k (in thousands) annualized.
Integration of AMS completed September 1, 2026; company expects AMS to contribute to consolidated results and noted incremental costs and amortization will affect near-term adjusted EPS and margins.
